messages.subject: Trouble with semTools::partialInvariance()
parts:
Hi all, thank you for such great work on a useful package.

We are trying to examine potential sources of scalar invariance using the function in the semTools package, partialInvariance().

We fit two models, using the lavaan::cfa() function, weak, and strong. We then used the following code to run the partialInvariance() function:

fit.loadings <- weak
fit.intercepts <- strong
x1 <- list(fit.loadings, fit.intercepts)
names(x1) <- c("fit.loadings", "fit.intercepts")
semTools::partialInvariance(x1, type="scalar") 

This returned the following error:

Error in x$cov[v, v] : subscript out of bounds

It is a bit hard to tell where to go from here. If we can share more information about the fitted models (weak and strong), please do let us know.

thank you very much for your help.

Josh

I agree, it's hard to tell where the problem starts just from that generic R message.  First, check that you are running the latest version of semTools (0.4-14) and lavaan (0.5-22 from CRAN, or the development version 0.5-23), on R 3.3.2:  

sessionInfo() 

The function is running fine for me, so if you are having this problem with the latest software, then please post (or send me) a reproducible example (R script and enough data to reproduce the error message).
